bio: An Argentinian restaurant that continues to gain in popularity, where the open grill is the focal point for everything that happens here. In this pleasant eatery run by two brothers, savour traditional dishes, gaucho specialities and different cuts of meat from a variety of breeds (Aberdeen Angus, Wagyu, Hereford, Vaca Gallega etc). The unusual collection of artisanal knives and the extensive list of Argentinian wines add to its appeal....
